# Storytelling

`editorial/storytelling` &middot; section-level &middot; category: editorial

## Purpose

A narrative section in a reading-width column: eyebrow, heading, paragraphs, an optional pull quote and an optional image.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` | text |  |
| `paragraphs` | listItems |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eyebrow` | text |  |
| `quote` | text |  |
| `quoteAuthor` | text |  |
| `image` | image { src, alt } |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Left-aligned story with the image on top.
- **centered**: Centered story. Sets `align: center`.
- **image-last**: The image after the story. Sets `imagePosition: bottom`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `imagePosition` | one of `top`, `bottom` | `"top"` |
| `maxWidth` | length | `"480px"` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Honored, a padded section with text. | Fine. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('editorial/storytelling', {
  "eyebrow": "Our story",
  "heading": "It started with one shirt and a stubborn idea",
  "paragraphs": [
    "In 2016 we could not find a linen shirt that survived a single summer, so we made one that would.",
    "Ten years and a lot of prototypes later, we still make every shirt the same way: slowly, in small batches, and with the people who sew them."
  ],
  "quote": "If it does not last, it does not leave the workshop.",
  "quoteAuthor": "Maya, co-founder",
  "image": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/480x320/png?text=Founders",
    "alt": "Two founders standing in their workshop holding a linen shirt"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "editorial/storytelling",
  "data": {
    "eyebrow": "Our story",
    "heading": "It started with one shirt and a stubborn idea",
```
